title: AlpineProtocol
description: alpine-code protocol version 2. Generated; do not edit.

AgentAsk.description:
One TF agent's call on an approval card: a card groups the agents that ask the same question, and shows each
one's call under its task.
AgentAsk.title: AgentAsk

AgentChangedItem.description: The agent was edited between two turns in a way the model sees.
AgentChangedItem.title: AgentChangedItem

AgentSwitchedItem.description: The session went on with another agent from here.
AgentSwitchedItem.title: AgentSwitchedItem

ChatGPTAccountInfo.description: The ChatGPT account behind a connection that signs in instead of using a key. Tokens never leave the server.
ChatGPTAccountInfo.title: ChatGPTAccountInfo

ChatGPTSignInFinishedParams.description: The end of a sign-in, whichever way it ended.
ChatGPTSignInFinishedParams.title: ChatGPTSignInFinishedParams

ChatGPTSignInParams.description:
Starts a sign-in. The app opens ``url`` in the browser and waits for ``chatgpt/signInFinished``. Starting one
cancels the sign-in still waiting, if any.
ChatGPTSignInParams.title: ChatGPTSignInParams

ChatGPTSignOutParams.description: Ends the connection's sign-in at OpenAI and forgets its tokens. The connection stays, signed out.
ChatGPTSignOutParams.title: ChatGPTSignOutParams

CheckStamp.description: Facts Alpine recorded about one check run (decisions 1 and 2).
CheckStamp.title: CheckStamp

CloneInfo.description: A repository being brought to this computer, or one that stopped before it got here.
CloneInfo.title: CloneInfo

CompactionItem.description: The conversation was tidied: old tool results cleared, then, if that was not enough, summarized.
CompactionItem.title: CompactionItem

ConnectionsAddParams.description: Saves a connection, replacing the one for the same provider or address, and its key.
ConnectionsAddParams.title: ConnectionsAddParams

ConnectionsModelsParams.description:
A saved connection by ``connection``, or one that may not be saved yet: a provider, or the address of a
compatible server. A ChatGPT connection is always a saved one.
ConnectionsModelsParams.title: ConnectionsModelsParams

ConnectionsRemoveParams.description: Forgets a connection and its saved key. A default model on it is cleared, so new sessions need a choice.
ConnectionsRemoveParams.title: ConnectionsRemoveParams

ConnectionsShowModelParams.description: Shows a model of a saved connection in the picker, or leaves it out.
ConnectionsShowModelParams.title: ConnectionsShowModelParams

ErrorData.description: ``data`` of an error the app can act on, beyond its message.
ErrorData.title: ErrorData

ExternalSessionInfo.description: A conversation Claude Code or Codex had in the folder, which can be carried over and continued here.
ExternalSessionInfo.title: ExternalSessionInfo

FeatureFile.description: ``.alpine-code/map/features/<id>.json``: one card, written by the agent.
FeatureFile.title: FeatureFile

FlowChange.description: One recorded change to the map, kept by the server next to the document.
FlowChange.title: FlowChange

FlowDeleteParams.description: Deletes the project's map: every file under ``.alpine-code/map/`` and this computer's records of it.
FlowDeleteParams.title: FlowDeleteParams

FlowEditParams.description:
The user rewrites one sentence of a card in the app. Alpine writes it into the card file and records it as the
user's own (decision 16). An empty ``value`` removes a promise or clears ``how_to_try``.
FlowEditParams.title: FlowEditParams

FlowFile.description: ``.alpine-code/map/flows/<id>.json``: one journey and the transitions between its cards, written by the agent.
FlowFile.title: FlowFile

FlowNode.description: A card as the app sees it: the agent's file plus the user's decisions and the session link Alpine keeps.
FlowNode.title: FlowNode

FlowNodeResult.description: Images for one card's checks, loaded when it opens.
FlowNodeResult.title: FlowNodeResult

FlowReplay.description:
How Alpine can re-run a check without a model (decision 5). The agent leaves it out for checks with side
effects such as real payments or mail.
FlowReplay.title: FlowReplay

FlowReviewParams.description: The user's answer to a change of something they decided, or to a "지도 고치기" session's result.
FlowReviewParams.title: FlowReviewParams

FlowSetParams.description: One of the user's own decisions. Only Alpine writes them, into its own state files.
FlowSetParams.title: FlowSetParams

GitHubReposParams.description:
The repositories the sign-in can see, the most recently pushed first. Fails with ``auth`` when signed out (or
GitHub no longer accepts the token, which is then forgotten) and ``unreachable`` when GitHub cannot be reached.
GitHubReposParams.title: GitHubReposParams

GitHubSignInFinishedParams.description: The end of a sign-in, whichever way it ended.
GitHubSignInFinishedParams.title: GitHubSignInFinishedParams

GitHubSignInParams.description: Starts a sign-in, cancelling one still waiting. The app shows ``user_code`` and opens ``verification_uri``.
GitHubSignInParams.title: GitHubSignInParams

GitHubSignOutParams.description: Forgets the sign-in here. GitHub keeps the grant until the user revokes it at ``access_url``.
GitHubSignOutParams.title: GitHubSignOutParams

ImportedItem.description: Where a conversation carried over from another app ends; the session goes on from here.
ImportedItem.title: ImportedItem

ItemModel.description: Base of the items. Serialized in full, so ``kind`` and nulls are always present.
ItemModel.title: ItemModel

MapCoverage.description: Changes the map does not cover (decision 3).
MapCoverage.title: MapCoverage

MapProblem.description: Something in the map files Alpine could not use. The rest of the map still shows.
MapProblem.title: MapProblem

MapReview.description: What a "지도 고치기" session changed, waiting for the user to accept it or put the map back (decision 16).
MapReview.title: MapReview

MapSchedule.description: The optional scheduled 지도 점검 (decision 6), kept on this computer.
MapSchedule.title: MapSchedule

MemoryChangedParams.description: A project's memories or suggestions changed; ``memory/list`` has the new ones.
MemoryChangedParams.title: MemoryChangedParams

MemoryCheck.description: What the harness checks while the agent works, in the forms memory rules take (English, for the model).
MemoryCheck.title: MemoryCheck

MemoryEvidence.description: Where a suggestion came from, as the harness saw it.
MemoryEvidence.title: MemoryEvidence

MemoryGuard.description: A call the user is always asked about, whatever the mode.
MemoryGuard.title: MemoryGuard

MemoryReviewItem.description:
Something the harness noticed about the project's memory during the run, waiting on the memory page. Only the
user reads it.
MemoryReviewItem.title: MemoryReviewItem

NoticeItem.description: A message the model reads that the user did not write.
NoticeItem.title: NoticeItem

Observation.description: One thing the agent saw while checking a promise, in words a non-developer can read.
Observation.title: Observation

ObservationProvenance.description: The server's label for one observation, computed on every read. The agent never writes it.
ObservationProvenance.title: ObservationProvenance

ObservationSource.description:
Where an observation came from, so Alpine can compare it with its own records. The agent writes this; the
server never trusts it without checking.
ObservationSource.title: ObservationSource

OfferedTool.description: A tool a session can get, and where it comes from.
OfferedTool.title: OfferedTool

ProductMap.description: The assembled map the app shows.
ProductMap.title: ProductMap

ProjectsArchiveParams.description: Takes a project off the rail; its sessions stay, and opening the folder brings it back.
ProjectsArchiveParams.title: ProjectsArchiveParams

ProjectsCancelCloneParams.description: Stops a clone and removes what it wrote, or dismisses a failed one. Does nothing for an unknown id.
ProjectsCancelCloneParams.title: ProjectsCancelCloneParams

ProjectsCloneChangedParams.description: A clone moved on: more received, or it finished (``done``, with ``project``), failed or was cancelled.
ProjectsCloneChangedParams.title: ProjectsCloneChangedParams

ProjectsCloneParams.description:
Brings a repository into the clone folder and opens it as a project.

Answers once the host has answered: with ``project`` when the repository is already here (a project with the same
``origin``, or the same repository in the clone folder) or the clone already finished, else with ``clone``, which
goes on in the background and announces itself through ``projects/cloneChanged``. A wrong address or a missing
sign-in fails the request itself (``no_access``, ``unreachable``, ``no_git_tools``, ``clone_failed``), so the app
can ask again before anything shows on the rail.
ProjectsCloneParams.title: ProjectsCloneParams

ProjectsDeleteParams.description: Forgets a project and what Alpine keeps about it. The folder and its files are never touched.
ProjectsDeleteParams.title: ProjectsDeleteParams

ProjectsInstallGitToolsParams.description: Opens Apple's installer for the command line developer tools. ``projects/gitTools`` says when it is done.
ProjectsInstallGitToolsParams.title: ProjectsInstallGitToolsParams

PromiseState.description: Everything Alpine computed about one promise.
PromiseState.title: PromiseState

RemovedCard.description: A card the user made decisions on (wrote, confirmed or planned) that is no longer in the map.
RemovedCard.title: RemovedCard

ReviewBlockedItem.description:
Auto mode's reviewer blocked a call; the model was told ``reason`` and went on. The call follows as a denied
``tool_call`` with the same ``call_id``.
ReviewBlockedItem.title: ReviewBlockedItem

RunStoppedItem.description: Why a run ended other than by answering.
RunStoppedItem.title: RunStoppedItem

SessionImportParams.description:
Carries a conversation over as a new session of ``cwd``; its earlier messages, tool calls and results come
with it, and the next message continues it.
SessionImportParams.title: SessionImportParams

SessionOpenResult.description: A snapshot. Apply the events whose ``seq`` is greater than ``seq``.
SessionOpenResult.title: SessionOpenResult

SessionSetAgentParams.description:
Goes on with another agent from the next message on. Not while the session runs. An unknown id fails with
``agent_not_found``.
SessionSetAgentParams.title: SessionSetAgentParams

SessionSetModelParams.description: Switches the model from the next message on; the conversation goes on. Not while the session runs.
SessionSetModelParams.title: SessionSetModelParams

SkillCandidate.description: A skill found at a source, not installed yet.
SkillCandidate.title: SkillCandidate

StatusLineItem.description: A line only the user reads.
StatusLineItem.title: StatusLineItem

TaskForceItem.description:
A TF: the session's model proposed it, then the user starts it and its agents work. Sent again with the same
id (``item_started``) as it changes; completed when it is over.
TaskForceItem.title: TaskForceItem

TaskForceMember.description: One agent of a TF, as the room and the agent list draw it.
TaskForceMember.title: TaskForceMember

TaskForceParams.description:
Names a TF of a session. ``taskforce/start`` (시작), ``taskforce/decline`` (혼자 하기), ``taskforce/stop``
(멈추기, 여기까지 결과 받기), ``taskforce/allowMore`` (more agents than planned) and ``taskforce/takeResults``
(after the app closed mid-run) take only this. A TF not in a state for the action fails with
``taskforce_state``; an unknown one with ``taskforce_not_found``.
TaskForceParams.title: TaskForceParams

TaskForceResumeParams.description: 이어 하기 after the app closed mid-run.
TaskForceResumeParams.title: TaskForceResumeParams

TaskForceStep.description: One step of the plan the card shows.
TaskForceStep.title: TaskForceStep

ToolSummary.description: A tool as the model sees it.
ToolSummary.title: ToolSummary

UnmappedPart.description: A part of the product the agent knows exists but has not mapped yet.
UnmappedPart.title: UnmappedPart
